name: colony stimulating factor 1

function.text: CSF1 encodes macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 [Cleaved into: Processed macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1; Macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 43 kDa subunit]. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine activity and growth factor activity. It participates in macrophage differentiation and monocyte activation.
